Weather favourability for wheat diseases — interpolated surface (separate product)

Colour shows weather favourability for the selected disease on the selected date: how favourable the measured weather was, nothing more. It is not disease risk, not predicted severity and not a forecast. Values are not comparable between diseases.
This is the interpolated variant. It draws a continuous surface between stations by inverse distance weighting. A surface like this was explicitly requested; it is a separate product from wheat_disease_map.html, which shows station values only and interpolates nothing. Every colour away from a marker is a guess, not a measurement. The leave-one-out cross-validation that quantifies how wrong that guess is sits in the panel on the right and in interpolation_validation.md — read it before using the surface for anything.
